description:
Apply the zero-copy integration contract only when it authorizes a bounded path through existing private abstractions; otherwise preserve the recorded no-change outcome.

## Background

This story never implements a public borrowed-word API or shared-infrastructure change, even if a pending owner decision is recorded for later work. A public/shared requirement is a terminal no-adoption outcome here and cannot be smuggled into production through test-only accessors, duplicated abstractions, or a later owner response outside this graph.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The approved existing-abstraction integration is implemented exactly for its bounded consumer, or the no-adoption contract leaves production unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: Shared semantic coverage proves correct offset handling, alignment behavior, logical length, zero tail padding, and 0/1/63/64/65 boundary results.
- [hard] REQ-03: No public borrowed-word API, shared-infrastructure change, second buffer abstraction, or dispatch bypass is implemented by this story branch.

## Notes

Before/after performance confirmation is intentionally separate from this code change; later public/shared work requires a separately authorized container.
title: Implement the approved private zero-copy outcome
